edges.reason: setOwner is guarded by the auth modifier which validates msg.sender via isAuthorized.
setAuthority is guarded by the auth modifier validating msg.sender.
setAdminByOwner requires msg.sender == owner.
setAdminByAdmin requires msg.sender == admin.
setOwnerByAdmin requires msg.sender == admin.
kill is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
withdrawStuckFunds is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
setAuthorized is onlyOwner and grants execution rights used by DFSProxy.
setAllAuthorized is onlyOwner and globally bypasses authorization.
givePermission is callable by anyone in the proxy context and grants execute rights.
callExecute is restricted to the configured monitor via onlyMonitor.
MCD callExecute is restricted to the configured monitor.
Aave callExecute is restricted to the configured monitor.
changeContractAddr is onlyOwner and gated by finalized.
lock is onlyOwner and freezes the registry.
callProxy is onlyAuthorized and relies on signature verification.
withdrawTokens sends the full balance to msg.sender with no caller restriction.
deposit pulls tokens from msg.sender via transferFrom.
getFee queries BotRegistry.botList(tx.origin) to lower the fee for bots.
changeMonitor stores block.timestamp into changeRequestedTimestamp.
confirmNewMonitor compares block.timestamp against the stored delay.
setOwner writes the new owner into DSAuth.owner.
setAuthority writes the new authority into DSAuth.authority.
setAdminByOwner stores the new admin address.
setAdminByAdmin stores the new admin address.
setOwnerByAdmin stores the new owner address.
setAuthorized writes into the authorized mapping.
setAllAuthorized writes the ALL_AUTHORIZED flag.
changeMonitor writes changeRequestedTimestamp.
confirmNewMonitor promotes newMonitor into monitor.
changeContractAddr writes into contractAddresses.
lock sets finalized to true.
kill performs selfdestruct on the owner address.
callExecute invokes DSProxy execute with arbitrary data and forwards value.
MCD callExecute invokes DSProxy execute with arbitrary data.
Aave callExecute invokes DSProxy execute with arbitrary data.
isAuthorized calls authority.canCall on an external contract before state changes.
givePermission calls DSGuardFactory/DSGuard external contracts.
removePermission calls the DSGuard forbid external contract.
getFee transfers feeAmount to WALLET_ADDR as ETH or ERC20.
getGasCost transfers gasCost to WALLET_ADDR.
sendContractBalance transfers the requested amount to a user.
sendFullContractBalance drains the whole balance to a user.
withdrawTokens transfers the entire contract balance to msg.sender.
getExpectedRate performs a low-level call to an arbitrary wrapper address.
takeOrder calls the arbitrary exchange address with value from exchange data.
_sell delegates to takeOrder or saverSwap which call external wrappers.
sendFullContractBalance delegates to sendContractBalance.
deposit calls approveToken to approve the lending pool core.
repay invokes _sell to convert collateral into the borrowed token.
boost invokes _sell to convert borrowed tokens into collateral.
Cream repay invokes _sell for the swap.
Cream boost invokes _sell for the swap.
_user parameter flows into AaveHelper.getFee for discount lookup.
_amount parameter flows into AaveBasicProxy.deposit for transferFrom.
_newMonitor parameter is stored by changeMonitor before timelock confirmation.
getFee computes local variable fee used to derive feeAmount.

normalization_plan.reason: _user parameter has meaning only inside AaveHelper.getFee, merge into that function node.
_amount parameter is consumed by AaveBasicProxy.deposit and has no standalone identity.
_newMonitor parameter is used only by CompoundMonitorProxy.changeMonitor.
local fee value is computed and consumed entirely inside AaveHelper.getFee.
